records.title: Roadside Supplies
records.briefing: Collect a fresh supply bundle from the caravan cache in Barren Plains.
records.completionText: You check the bundle against the current shipping list and secure it for the return journey.

records.title: Forest Samples
records.briefing: Collect this week's marked herb samples in Enchanted Forest.
records.completionText: You seal fresh leaves and soil in labeled jars, recording where each sample was gathered.

records.title: Rat-Clearing Contract
records.briefing: Remove a Rat Swarm from the storehouses of Ghost Town.
records.completionText: The storehouse is clear for now. You mark the inspected entrance on the contract.

records.title: Swamp Survey
records.briefing: Measure water levels and inspect the survey stakes in Murky Swamp.
records.completionText: You replace two sinking stakes and record the changed waterline for the surveyors.

records.title: Wolf Bounty
records.briefing: Defeat a Direwolf threatening travelers in Shadowed Grove.
records.completionText: The wolf no longer blocks the trail. Your report identifies the crossing that needs another patrol.

records.title: Ironward Patrol
records.briefing: Intercept a Goblin Scout in Eldritch Forest on the Company's behalf.
records.completionText: You recover the scout's latest trail markings and make the patrol route safe to use again.

records.title: Archive Maintenance
records.briefing: Gather loose catalog pages from Enchanted Library.
records.completionText: You sort the scattered catalog slips into their numbered cases for the archivists.

records.title: Cargo Recovery
records.briefing: Retrieve the newly reported cargo crate at Bandit Hideout.
records.completionText: The crate's serial number matches the current contract. You prepare it for its rightful owner.

records.title: Crown Road Watch
records.briefing: Defeat a Goblin Marauder on the road through Whispering Woods.
records.completionText: The road is clear. You log the attack site for the next escort leaving Ariandel, The Royal Capital.

records.title: Cavern Salvage
records.briefing: Collect marked expedition salvage from Crystal Caverns.
records.completionText: You gather the numbered salvage pieces and leave unstable debris for a better-equipped team.

records.title: Milepost Inspection
records.briefing: Inspect the road markers in Barren Plains and note damaged signs.
records.completionText: Your inspection sheet lists two leaning posts and a missing distance plate for the road crew.

records.title: Oasis Well Check
records.briefing: Test the well and clean its collection basin at Desert Oasis.
records.completionText: The basin runs clear again. You bottle a water sample for the guild's examiner.

records.title: Viper Removal
records.briefing: Defeat a Viper nesting along the paths in Murky Swamp.
records.completionText: The nest is cleared and marked. Collectors can use the narrow path again.

records.title: Frost Readings
records.briefing: Record ice depth at the marked station in Frozen Tundra.
records.completionText: You record the latest ice readings and reset the station's wind-battered measuring pole.

records.title: Belfry Clearance
records.briefing: Defeat Blood Bats roosting in the tower of Abandoned Castle.
records.completionText: The belfry is clear. You flag the broken window through which the next swarm might enter.

records.title: Watchpost Rations
records.briefing: Collect a fresh ration delivery at Barren Plains for the Ironward watch.
records.completionText: You tally the rations and sign the latest delivery sheet for the watchpost quartermaster.

records.title: Botanical Ink
records.briefing: Gather marked ink-producing plants from Enchanted Forest for the scholars.
records.completionText: The fresh stems are bundled separately so their dyes will not mix before the scribes prepare them.

records.title: Caravan Audit
records.briefing: Check the stored merchant seals at Desert Oasis against the Consortium's register.
records.completionText: You compare each seal with the register and record discrepancies for the next caravan master.

records.title: Dispatch Cache Check
records.briefing: Inspect the Crownward dispatch cache in Whispering Woods.
records.completionText: The cache is dry and its locks hold. You replace the weathered route notice with a fresh copy.

records.title: Tidal Marker Survey
records.briefing: Read the tide markers in Pirate Cove for the Tidebound chartmakers.
records.completionText: You note the new high-water line and sketch the shifting sandbar beside the cove entrance.
